author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Apple is scheduled to hold its fall product event Wednesday, the company’s first major launch presentation under chief executive John Ternus.

Reuters reported that Apple is expected to introduce its next iPhone lineup and may unveil a long-anticipated foldable model. The company had confirmed the September 9 event date but had not preannounced the devices, so product names, specifications and prices circulating before the presentation remain expectations rather than confirmed facts.

Ternus, Apple’s longtime hardware chief, became CEO September 1 as Tim Cook moved to executive chairman. That leadership change puts unusual attention on how the event frames Apple’s hardware priorities and its approach to artificial intelligence on consumer devices.

A foldable phone would place Apple in a segment already served by several rivals and could lift average selling prices, but demand will depend on durability, software and cost. The event itself will determine which reports were accurate. Customers considering an upgrade should wait for Apple’s published specifications and availability details rather than treating advance reports as final.
dek: The September 9 showcase is expected to introduce new iPhones and could offer the first public look at Apple’s next hardware strategy.
headline: Apple set for first major product event under new CEO
